changelog:
Artifacts Builder 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a toolkit for building sophisticated, multi-component HTML artifacts for claude.ai using React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.
- Provides step-by-step scripts for rapidly initializing, developing, and bundling projects into single, shareable HTML files.
- Bundling pipeline uses Vite, Parcel, and html-inline to produce self-contained artifacts.
- Pre-installs 40+ shadcn/ui components and configures modern frontend standards.
- Includes design guidelines to avoid common poor visual patterns ("AI slop").
